name: How long should I wait before relisting my house?

mainEntity.name: How long should I wait before relisting my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal waiting period before relisting varies, typically ranging from 30 to 90 days. This allows time for market conditions to shift, for you to make necessary property improvements, and to avoid the perception of an 'stale' listing. Our agents can advise on the optimal timing based on current market activity in your specific area, whether it's a bustling market like Brickell or a more seasonal one like Key Biscayne.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wait 30-90 days before relisting to allow for market shifts and property improvements, avoiding a 'stale' listing appearance.
